scope: Close the existing Gate 4 contracts and four R6 blockers; no new features or optional cleanup

contracts.rule: Production datasets and final-label boundaries cannot be weakened by supplied metadata
contracts.remaining_proof: Both datasets, every production loader, and positive frozen-data path; explicit synthetic seam only

contracts.rule: Accepted requests execute the authorized configuration once within the two-job quota
contracts.remaining_proof: HTTP to persisted configuration, cross-session denial, process-level quota and replay on both backends

contracts.rule: Continuation completion includes every dependency in the same generation and retry receipts are stable
contracts.remaining_proof: Bind/resume race, lost-response replay, terminal rebind, failed dependencies and cross-session binding

contracts.rule: Only the current authorized owner may mutate a job and cancellation cannot be lost
contracts.remaining_proof: Claim/expiry/cancel/failure/reclaim races and autonomous HTTP execution on both backends

contracts.rule: Reservation, normal completion and recovery enforce the same generation/job/attempt/fence/content identity atomically
contracts.remaining_proof: Each mismatched owner field, legacy metadata, live CLI protection, crash points, malformed metadata and rollback across all result/audit/event/publication tables

contracts.rule: Scientific identities and projections are independently validated rather than trusted from producer metadata
contracts.remaining_proof: Exact keys, logical/experiment/condition/comparison preimages, DB-to-disk projection binding, valid fixture and affected clean-source reproduction

contracts.rule: Source, installed package and supported existing databases share the same migration/runtime contract
contracts.remaining_proof: Installed-wheel head and upgrade, legacy sessions and isolated PostgreSQL16 runtime; compilation/version smoke alone is insufficient

contracts.rule: Evidence identifies one unchanged candidate and never inherits a previous PASS
contracts.remaining_proof: No required skip, explicit early-failure status, exact clean source identity, no edited old artifacts and independent acceptance
